name: capacitylens-app
description: CapacityLens QA capacity utilization demo — API + dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build:pages: npm run export-static && cross-env GITHUB_PAGES=true VITE_STATIC_API=true npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/prepare-pages.js
